regime_context: The detector shows a broad Materials/Energy-led tape on the TSX with Base Metals & Copper as the leader, challenged closely by Oil & Gas Producers, while the index-level narrative is one of geopolitics with an unscheduled-surprise share of 1.0. The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control on this market (gate_helps=true), but cross-sectional rank-IC is weak and rotation timing is display-only, so this is a discipline/focus lens, not a return forecast.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Base Metals & Copper (rank 1) holds above Oil & Gas Producers (rank 2) through the next 10 sessions: the margin is only 0.11 and both are eligible/non-crowded. A confirmed handoff would be Oil & Gas ranking above Base Metals for five consecutive sessions with the Base Metals durability_bar falling below 0.4, which would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The leading theme by rank (score 1.655) with durability_bar 0.5 and breadth 0.556 (only modestly above the 0.5 cohesion mark), not crowded (z=0.9), with the largest eligible-cash weight in the headline (0.25). The trend gate flags it eligible, and per backtest the gate's value is staying-power/shake-out control rather than return edge, so the lean is a trend-continuation tilt on the incumbent leader, not a forecast of outperformance.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert, and the track_record dir_accuracy is only 0.371, suggesting the leader's continued outperformance is weak-to-random; geopolitics-driven commodity spikes tend to be sharp and short-lived.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO trails the S&P/TSX composite by more than 4% over any 10-session window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Rank 2 with score 1.545, the challenger to Base Metals with a small margin (0.11). Durability 0.61 is stronger than the leader's, breadth 0.571 slightly better, and crowding_z 0.97 is still below the crowded threshold. Same logic as the leader: an eligible, non-crowded, high-durability trend tilt, with the challenger leg supported by slightly stronger absolute trend discipline.
theses.dissent: Energy is cyclically exposed to the geopolitics headline in the macro narrative with unscheduled_share 1.0, which can reverse violently; Hurst is mixed, so the trend is not clean.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO falls below its 50-day moving average and stays there for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Rank 5, eligible=true, and one of only two themes tagged hurst_tag=trend in the top half (the other being Pipelines/Midstream, which is unscorable). Durability 0.6 is solid, breadth 0.286 is thinner but Banks are a defensive-financials anchor in a geopolitics-driven tape, and the trend gate's validated shake-out control applies; a low-conviction structural tilt on a trend-healthy, non-crowded incumbent rather than a momentum call.
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.286 means the leadership is narrow/not broadly confirmed within the theme; in a full risk-on rotation to commodities, financials may lag significantly.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO gives up more than 5% relative to the S&P/TSX composite before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
